caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded stoneware jug with a narrow neck and a small lip at the opening, positioned centrally on a plain background. The jug is a beige or light tan color, with the upper third featuring dark blue text in two lines that reads “KLINCK & WICKENBERG. CHARLESTON, S.C.” A number "3" appears above the text, also in blue. Below the text, there is a decorative blue floral or plant-like motif with three sets of stylized leaves or petals emanating from a central point. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a faint pencil sketch of a partial, abstract form that resembles a curved section of the jug. The drawing is signed "Annie B. Johnston" in the lower right corner. The entire drawing is bordered by two lightly drawn rectangular lines, one closer to the jug and one further out.
title: Stoneware Jug
